energy_reporting: Both full-route 75kg-reference energy (to reconcile the prior snapshot) and EV2 phase energy (empty deadhead to pickup plus passenger load from pickup to dropoff) are included.
scope: Only parent-manifest completed tasks with fixed exact endpoints. Same frozen map and local PackageConfig graph are used for local_dijkstra and R4. Semantic endpoint tasks are excluded so endpoint understanding is not conflated with route-search quality.
